title: Hetu (3)
text: 1-2 Sāvatthi || || Tatra || voca || || 3 Rūpam bhikkhave ānattā || yo pi hetu yo pi paccayo rūpassa uppādāya so pi anattā || anattasambhūtam bhikkhave rūpam kuto attā bhavissati || || 4-6 Vedanā anattā || Saññā anattā || Saṅkhārā anattā || 7 Viññāṇam anattā || yo pi hetu yo pi paccayo viññāṇassa uppādāya so pi anattā || anattasambhūtam bhikkhave viññāṇaṃ kuto attā bhavissati || || 8 Evam passaṃ || la || nāparam itthattāyāti pajānātīti || ||
